UI_trait_DanDependentdesc:
Cannot go long without a drink.
A day dry brings craving, stress, low mood and poor sleep.
Two days dry brings pain, nausea and the shakes.
For a heavy drinker, three days dry brings hallucinations and seizures.
The deeper the habit, the sooner and harder it hits, and the more it takes to feel a drink.
A month without alcohol breaks it, but any drink after that risks a relapse.
Anyone who drinks too often can become an Alcoholic.
UI_trait_DanBrittledesc:
Bones give out easily.
Hard hits can fracture an arm, hand or leg.
Fractures must be splinted.
UI_trait_DanArthritisdesc:
Stiff, painful joints.
Hands and legs are always a little stiff: slower to move, slower to swing.
Cold and damp bring a flare: more pain, more stiffness.
Painkillers ease the ache, not the stiffness.
An unreliable grip: a swing can slip and land weak, more often when panicked, hurt, tired or flaring. In a bad flare a slip can throw the weapon to the ground.
UI_trait_DanJinxeddesc:
Luck is not on your side.
Containers looted for the first time nearby sometimes lose an item.
UI_trait_DanSpiralingdesc:
Depressive episodes hold mood down for days.
Pain, stress, exhaustion and time indoors bring them on.
Exercise, time outdoors, a drink, a smoke or comfort food ease them.
Antidepressants help after two weeks of daily use; stopping hurts.
UI_trait_DanBadDaydesc:
Everything went wrong this morning.
Starts blind drunk, with a cold, a shard of glass in the groin, no clothes and soaked.
If indoors, the house is on fire.
You remember a sewing kit in a drawer next door, if you can get there.
Applied once, to a new character.
UI_DanTraits_AlcoholicGained: You've come to need a drink
UI_DanTraits_AlcoholicRelapse: One drink was all it took
UI_trait_DanSchizophreniadesc:
Sees and hears things that are not there.
Phantom zombies, groans, thumps, whispers and breaking glass.
Sudden bouts of panic.
Worse when stressed, unhappy, tired or at night.
UI_trait_DanAsthmadesc:
Airways irritated by cold air, corpses, exertion and panic.
Builds from tight chest to wheezing, coughing and an attack.
Rest in clean, warm air clears it. Masks help.
A rescue inhaler cuts it back. Starts with one.
Cannot be taken with Asthmatic.
UI_DanTraits_AsthmaBlackout: You come round, wheezing on the floor
UI_DanTraits_DiaBlackout: You come round on the floor, shaking
UI_trait_DanGlutendesc:
Wheat makes you ill.
Bread, pasta, cereal, pastry and beer bring cramps, nausea and low mood.
Worse the more you ate. Takes hours to clear.
UI_trait_DanVegetariandesc:
Does not eat animals.
Meat, fish, insects and dishes made with them are refused.
Eggs and dairy are fine.
UI_trait_DanDiabetes1desc:
Makes no insulin.
Blood sugar climbs with carbohydrates and on its own.
Only injected insulin brings it down.
Low: shakes, panic, dropped weapons. High: thirst, nausea, harm.
Starts with a glucose meter, test strips and insulin pens.
Cannot be taken with Type 2.
UI_trait_DanDiabetes2desc:
Body weight sets insulin resistance.
Blood sugar settles high and clears slowly when heavy.
Exercise, losing weight and metformin help.
Starts with a glucose meter, test strips and metformin.
Cannot be taken with Type 1.
UI_trait_DanRenFairedesc: Every summer at the faire turns out to have been training.
UI_trait_DanGymRegulardesc:
Keeps a training routine.
Every exercise starts at half regularity.
Applied once, to a new character.
UI_trait_DanCaffeinedesc:
Cannot function without caffeine.
Coffee, tea and caffeine pills count in full; cola and chocolate only put it off for a few hours.
Half a day without brings a headache, tiredness and low mood.
A week without breaks the habit.
UI_trait_DanMigrainedesc:
Prone to migraines.
Bad sleep, thirst, stress, hangovers, heat, the smell of the dead, a storm on the way and bright daylight bring them on. Three of these are yours and hit hard; the rest count for less. You find out which over time.
An aura gives twenty minutes warning.
Hours of pain, nausea and blurred vision. Ordinary painkillers barely touch it; sumatriptan, rare, ends it within two hours. Light drags it out, a dark room or sleep ends it sooner.
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTriptan: The sumatriptan is taking the edge off
UI_DanTraits_TriptanAfter: Sumatriptan: heavy-limbed and a little clumsy
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_sleep: Your migraines follow a bad night
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_thirst: Your migraines come when you go without water
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_light: Bright light sets your migraines off
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_heat: The heat sets your migraines off
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_corpses: The stench of the dead sets your migraines off
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_storm: Your migraines come before a storm
UI_trait_DanHemophiliadesc:
Blood does not clot.
Bleeding never stops on its own and you lose far more blood.
Open wounds bleed again until bandaged.
A scratch is a bandage or a slow death.
UI_trait_DanAnemiadesc:
Short of iron.
Without fresh meat, fish, greens, eggs or iron pills the deficit shows within days.
Endurance recovers slower, tiredness comes sooner, colds catch easier.
UI_trait_DanIronStomachdesc:
Can eat almost anything.
Rotten and burnt food does half the harm to your diet.
Food sickness climbs half as fast.
UI_trait_DanEarlyRiserdesc:
Up with the sun, and glad of it.
Starts well rested.
Every night counts for a little more.
Applied once, to a new character.
UI_trait_DanMealPrepperdesc:
Plans meals ahead.
Starts on a good diet.
Variety counts over five days instead of three.
Applied once, to a new character.
UI_trait_DanDeepSleeperdesc:
Sleeps like a rock.
Needs less sleep.
Light rarely wakes you, and costs less rest when it does not.
Sleeping in the dark does even more good.
Cannot be taken with Sleepyhead or Restless Sleeper.
UI_trait_DanAge20sdesc:
Young, and the body shows it.
Endurance comes back a quarter faster.
Fitness and Strength train half as fast again.
Scratches, cuts and open deep wounds heal half as fast again, and stiffness fades half as fast again.
Sleeps through more, rebuilds blood and shakes off a concussion faster, and hangovers are milder.
No extra level in the profession's main skill (the 30s get one).
Gym Regular starts at 65 regularity instead of 50.
Cannot be taken with Handy or Arthritis.
UI_trait_DanAge30sdesc:
Neither young nor old: the body works as it always has.
One extra level in the profession's main skill.
UI_trait_DanAge40sdesc:
Years on the job.
Two extra levels in the profession's main skill (the 30s get one) and one in each of its other skills.
Handy gives one more level of Carpentry.
The body is a little slower: endurance, wound healing, stiffness, and Fitness and Strength training (a tenth slower).
Wakes more in the night, rebuilds blood and gets over a concussion slower, and hangovers are worse.
Arthritis flares sooner, Brittle bones snap more often, and a Heart Condition acts up more.
Staying in shape costs more: Strong and Athletic 2 points more, Stout and Fit 1.
UI_trait_DanAge50sdesc:
A lifetime of knowing how, in a body that keeps the receipts.
Three extra levels in the profession's main skill (the 30s get one) and two in each of its other skills.
Handy gives one more level of Carpentry.
The body is slower: endurance, wound healing, stiffness (still sore the day after), and Fitness and Strength training (a fifth slower).
Wakes often in the night, rebuilds blood and gets over a concussion much slower, and hangovers are half as bad again.
Arthritis flares much sooner, Brittle bones snap half as often again, and a Heart Condition acts up more.
Staying in shape costs more: Strong and Athletic 4 points more, Stout and Fit 2.
UI_trait_NightVisionDesc:
Better vision at night.
Light wakes you more easily.
UI_trait_SmokerDesc:
Cravings build between cigarettes, faster the heavier the habit.
Withdrawal brings irritability, hunger and restless sleep; a cigarette only relieves the craving it answers.
Damaged lungs: endurance recovers slower, and a cough that carries, worse on exertion and in the morning.
Three weeks without tobacco breaks the habit; nicotine gum eases the way. After that, a drink or a bad day brings the cravings back.
Anyone who smokes too often can become a Smoker.
UI_DanTraits_InfectionLocal: The wound is hot and red
UI_DanTraits_DressingSpent: The dressing on your %1 needs changing
UI_DanTraits_WoundOpened: The wound on your %1 opened up
UI_DanTraits_BadSet: The bone in your %1 isn't set right
UI_DanTraits_ConcussionLateEnd: The headache from that knock finally lifts
UI_DanTraits_PoorStitches: The stitches in your %1 came out rough
UI_DanTraits_health_StitchesFresh: Stitches fresh, go easy on it
UI_DanTraits_health_ConcussionLate: Headache after a knock to the head
UI_DanTraits_ComeTo: You come round on the floor
UI_DanTraits_BloodComeTo: You come round, cold and shaking
UI_DanTraits_health_KnockToHead: Took a knock to the head
UI_trait_HemophobicDesc:
The sight of blood is too much.
Panics at your own bleeding, and gets stressed when bloody.
Treating a wound takes longer, and stitching, pulling out glass or a bullet, or dressing a bleeding wound can make you faint.
Losing blood fast can make you faint.
Cannot perform first aid on others.
UI_DanTraits_FaintBlood: You come round, pale and shaking
UI_trait_DanHeartdesc:
A weak heart that shows itself under strain.
Only while the Endurance moodle shows: chest pain, worse the more worn out, more likely when panicking, older, a smoker or on caffeine.
Stop and rest and it passes. Keep running or fighting through it and it can become a heart attack: you go down, lose health, and recover slowly for a day.
Beta blockers, one every 12 hours, make it much less likely. Starts with two bottles.
UI_trait_DanEpilepsydesc:
Seizures.
Tiredness, alcohol withdrawal, a hangover, a fever, a concussion, stress, dehydration and bright sunlight bring them on.
A few minutes' warning, then you drop what you hold and go down for a few minutes, and wake confused with a headache.
Anticonvulsants, one every 12 hours, make them much rarer. Starts with a bottle.
UI_trait_DanTinnitusdesc:
Damaged ears.
A burst of gunfire (half a dozen pistol shots, three from a shotgun) leaves you half deaf and ringing for a while: Hard of Hearing, longer the louder it got.
The ringing makes light sleep lighter.
Cannot be taken with Hard of Hearing or Deaf.
UI_trait_DanLactosedesc:
Dairy disagrees with you.
Milk, cheese, butter, cream, yogurt and ice cream bring mild cramps, queasiness and low mood.
Worse the more you had. Takes a few hours to clear.
UI_trait_DanGermaphobedesc:
Dirt gets under your skin.
Dirty or bloody skin and dirty clothes build stress and hold your mood down, and it only takes a few filthy patches.
Washing up and changing brings real relief.
Wounds are a little less likely to become infected.
UI_trait_DanStraightEdgedesc:
Never touches alcohol or tobacco.
Refuses drinks, cigarettes, cigars, pipes and chewing tobacco, and the relief they would bring.
Cannot be taken with Alcoholic, Smoker, Hollow Legs or A Really Bad Day.
UI_trait_DanSteadyHandsdesc:
Includes Dexterous: faster inventory transfers.
Splints you set go wrong and stitches you put in come out rough half as often.
Your fresh stitches tear half as often.
Stitching, pulling out glass or a bullet and splinting take a quarter less time.
Not while your hands shake: alcohol withdrawal or low blood sugar.
Cannot be taken with Dexterous or All Thumbs.
UI_trait_DanNightShiftdesc:
Used to sleeping by day.
Between 6 AM and 8 PM, light rarely wakes you and costs little rest.
Cannot be taken with Early Riser.
UI_trait_DanHollowLegsdesc:
Holds a drink well.
Every drink goes to your head a fifth less: it takes more to get drunk, and more to dull pain.
Hangovers are milder and shorter.
Cannot be taken with Straight Edge.
UI_trait_DanFastRecoverydesc:
Includes Fast Healer: wounds heal faster.
After a bleed, blood volume and red cells come back half as fast again.
Cannot be taken with Fast Healer or Slow Healer.
UI_trait_DanGoodClotterdesc:
Blood clots quickly.
Bleeding stops on its own twice as fast, except around glass or a bullet still in the wound.
A bleed loses a quarter less blood.
Cannot be taken with Hemophilia.
UI_trait_DanThickSkulldesc:
Hard-headed.
A knock to the head concusses half as often, and less badly.
Concussions heal half as fast again.
Stacks with a helmet.
UI_trait_outdoorsmandesc:
Less affected by harsh weather conditions.
Takes twice as long to get sunburnt.
UI_DanTraits_HeartChestPain: A tight, crushing pain in your chest
UI_DanTraits_HeartComeRound: You come round, grey and weak
UI_DanTraits_EpilepsyAura: A strange feeling rising. A seizure is coming
UI_DanTraits_EpilepsyComeRound: You come round, confused and aching
UI_DanTraits_HeartBetaLapse: Your beta blockers are wearing off
UI_DanTraits_EpilepsyNight: A seizure in your sleep. You wake aching and worn out
UI_DanTraits_SunblockOff: Your sun block has worn off
UI_trait_DanMSdesc:
Heat is the enemy, and no medicine helps with it. You warm up faster than most, and discomfort wears you down.
Warm: you tire sooner. Hot: stiff, clumsy, painful hands and a weapon that slips. Overheated: severe pain and hands that give out.
Cool down with shade, water, wet clothes and rest.
Flares about once a month, worse with fever or stress: days of stiff legs, weak hands and exhaustion.
Your energy is a budget of spoons: a day's worth after a good night, fewer after a bad one. Everything spends them, faster in the heat or a flare. Run out and you hit the wall; push on and you borrow from tomorrow. Rest gives a little back, and a book costs next to nothing.
Prednisone shortens a flare, baclofen eases the stiffness, amantadine adds spoons to every morning. Starts with baclofen and amantadine.
UI_DanTraits_MSHeat1: The heat is getting to you
UI_DanTraits_MSHeat2: Too hot. Your hands are going clumsy and sore
UI_DanTraits_MSHeat3: Overheated. Your hands are barely working. Cool down
UI_DanTraits_MSFlare: An MS flare. Your legs are heavy and your hands weak

UI_DanTraits_MedSide_baclofen: Baclofen: your muscles feel weak today

UI_DanTraits_MedOver_anticonvulsant: Too many anticonvulsants: you feel heavy and sluggish
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_metformin: Too much metformin: you feel sick
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_diazepam: Too much diazepam: you can barely keep your eyes open
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_prednisone: Too much prednisone: you feel wired and ravenous
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_baclofen: Too much baclofen: your muscles feel like water
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_amantadine: Too much amantadine: you feel jittery and confused
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_inhaler: Too many puffs: your hands shake and your heart races
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_nicotinegum: Too much nicotine gum: you feel sick and dizzy
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_painkillers: Too many painkillers: you feel very sick
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_sumatriptan: Too much sumatriptan: your chest feels tight
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_sleepingtablets: Too many sleeping tablets: you can barely stay awake
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_caffeinepills: Too many caffeine pills: you are jittery and your heart pounds
